# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> Frank V Murphy & Co. are delighted to present this two-bedroom mid-terrace residence ideally located in a highly convenient residential area, just a short walk from Cork City Centre. No. 67 High Street presents an excellent opportunity for both first-time buyers and investors seeking a well-located unrestricted rental property.
